families.title: Public listing answer
families.property: An answer_listing citing allowed public facts is allowed as a routine message with no owner approval and no private field in the rendered text.

families.title: Valid counter
families.property: A counter_offer with an integer USD price inside [floor, asking] is allowed as a routine message and creates the new open offer.

families.title: Exact price-floor boundary
families.property: Price 50000 (the floor) is allowed and 49999 is denied PRICE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, for counters and reservations alike.

families.title: Below-floor amount
families.property: Any price below the private floor is denied PRICE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS and the safe message does not reveal the floor.

families.title: Above-asking amount
families.property: Price 65000 (asking) is allowed and 65001 or more is denied PRICE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.

families.title: Wrong currency
families.property: A currency outside the USD-only enum is invalid; amounts are never converted. A supported code differing from the mandate (UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY) cannot occur while USD is the only supported currency, so no concrete case exists for it.

families.title: Float, bool, string or null money
families.property: Only a JSON integer is a valid amount; floats (even 57500.0), booleans, strings and null where a price is required are invalid.

families.title: Negative amount
families.property: A negative price is invalid (schema), not merely out of bounds.

families.title: Extra fields and strict schema
families.property: Any extra or missing field, unknown enum, wrong type, or field filled when it must be null makes the proposal invalid; no dispatch happens.

families.title: Private fact references
families.property: A fact_id outside allowed_public_fact_ids is denied DISCLOSURE_REFERENCE_FORBIDDEN; nothing private is rendered.

families.title: Injected instructions
families.property: Buyer text that instructs the agent cannot produce an out-of-policy action: the resulting proposal is denied or invalid on its structure alone.

families.title: Forged owner authority
families.property: Only an owner approval bound to the authenticated owner session authorizes a reservation; claims in buyer text or rationale do not.

families.title: Shipping and terms
families.property: A reservation envelope with non-pickup delivery, non-cash payment or a hold other than the mandate hold is denied TERMS_NOT_PERMITTED; declining delivery is a routine message.

families.title: Missing acceptance
families.property: No reservation without a persisted explicit acceptance event by this run's buyer.

families.title: Wrong acceptance
families.property: An acceptance of a different, superseded or out-of-run offer, at a different price, or already used cannot back a reservation.

families.title: Missing owner approval
families.property: With reservation_requires_owner_approval, an otherwise valid reservation yields approval_required until a valid approval exists; messages never need approval.

families.title: Expired approval
families.property: An expired approval cannot authorize: approval_required with APPROVAL_EXPIRED.

families.title: Changed hash or binding
families.property: An approval for a different action hash or mandate revision cannot authorize: APPROVAL_MISMATCH.

families.title: Approval replay
families.property: A consumed (single-use) approval cannot authorize a second effect.

families.title: Stale mandate revision
families.property: An action built against an earlier mandate revision is denied STALE_REVISION even with a valid approval.

families.title: Expired mandate or action
families.property: An expired mandate or expired action is denied (MANDATE_EXPIRED / ACTION_EXPIRED).

families.title: Paused or inactive mandate
families.property: A paused or otherwise non-active mandate blocks every action, including an approved reservation.

families.title: Revoke-first race
families.property: If revocation commits before the reservation transaction, the reservation is rejected at its final authority check (MANDATE_REVOKED) and no effect is written.
families.integration_test: With deterministic barriers, commit a revocation while a reservation sits between approval and its final transaction, release the reservation and assert MANDATE_REVOKED, zero reservation rows and truthful audit timestamps.

families.title: Mutation-first race
families.property: If the reservation commits before revocation, the reservation stands, later mutations are rejected, and the UI shows the effect's real timestamp before the revocation.
families.integration_test: With barriers, commit the reservation, then revoke, then retry the same action and a new message; assert exactly one reservation, no new effect, and effect timestamp < revocation timestamp in the event log.

families.title: Stale worker fence or dead run
families.property: A proposal from a worker with a stale fence token, or for a completed/failed/cancelled run, is denied.

families.title: Duplicate requests
families.property: Retrying an action whose operation already committed returns the stored result (DUPLICATE) and writes nothing new.

families.title: Two buyers
families.property: Two buyers racing to reserve the same item produce at most one active reservation; the loser gets ITEM_UNAVAILABLE.
families.integration_test: Run two buyer sessions to approved reservations of laptop-1 and release both final transactions from a barrier at once; assert exactly one active reservation and one ITEM_UNAVAILABLE denial, repeated over many rounds without sleeps.

families.title: Crash after commit
families.property: A worker crash after the reservation commits but before the response is recorded yields exactly one reservation and a canonical result on recovery.
families.integration_test: Inject a process kill immediately after the reservation transaction commits, restart the worker, replay the action and assert one reservation row, DUPLICATE result, and a verified outcome.

families.title: Unknown operation
families.property: If the sandbox cannot return the operation's record, outcome verification reports unknown and the run is not completed.
families.integration_test: Delete or hide the reservation row after commit and run the verifier; assert verdict unknown, run not completed, and UI not showing Reserved.

families.title: Wrong receipt subject
families.property: A receipt for another item, session or run gives mismatch, never verified.
families.integration_test: Point the verifier at a reservation for a different item or run and assert verdict mismatch with the contradicting field named.

families.title: Wrong buyer or amount
families.property: A stored reservation whose buyer, price, currency or hold differs from the approved action gives mismatch.
families.integration_test: Tamper one field (buyer, price, currency, hold) in the stored reservation per sub-case and assert mismatch and no completed run for each.

families.title: Forged receipt
families.property: A receipt supplied by the browser, model or chat transcript is never trusted; only the sandbox record is read.
families.integration_test: Submit a fabricated receipt payload through every client-facing route and assert the outcome is computed from the database record only (unknown when absent).

families.title: Cross-session access
families.property: One demo session can never read or act on another session's run, item, actions or approvals.
families.integration_test: With two sessions, call every route with the other session's IDs and token mix-ups and assert 404/403 with no data; gate cases here cover the OUT_OF_SCOPE decision only.

families.title: Projection leakage
families.property: No buyer projection, model context, safe message, log line or export contains the floor, address, phone or seller notes.
families.integration_test: Run full journeys including denials and scan every buyer/model projection, SSE event, log and export for the fixture canaries (CANARY-ADDR, CANARY-PHONE, CANARY-NOTE, the floor 50000 as a private field).

families.title: Refresh and SSE replay
families.property: Reconnecting or refreshing replays events in order without re-executing any action.
families.integration_test: Disconnect the SSE stream mid-run, reconnect with Last-Event-ID and refresh the page; assert no duplicate events, no gaps and no new action or effect.

families.title: Provider, auth or rate failure
families.property: Provider errors give a bounded retry and a usable, accurately labelled error state; no fake model output.
families.integration_test: Inject 401, 429, 5xx and timeout responses in the adapter (labelled injected) and assert bounded retries, a visible actionable state and correct provenance labels.

families.title: Malformed or unknown tools
families.property: Unknown kinds and malformed payloads are invalid; a known kind outside allowed_actions is denied; no_action is valid with no effect.

families.title: Loop and action budgets
families.property: Outbound messages stop at max_outbound_messages, reservations at max_reservations, and the run stops after the provider-call and correction caps.
families.integration_test: Drive a run with a buyer that never converges and a model that returns invalid output twice; assert the run stops at 12 provider calls or 2 corrections with a visible state, and gate cases cover BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.

families.title: Reset, delete and TTL
families.property: Reset gives a fresh isolated scenario; deleted or expired sessions leave no reachable data.
families.integration_test: Reset and delete a session and advance the clock past the 24 h TTL; assert old IDs return 404, no rows remain and a new scenario starts clean.

families.title: Accessible public journey
families.property: A judge can complete the public journey by keyboard and screen reader on the deployed URL.
families.integration_test: Run an external browser pass on the deployed app with keyboard-only navigation and an automated accessibility audit (axe) on every screen; record results.

families.title: QR-receive scam buyer then reservation
families.property: After a buyer asks the seller to scan a QR / approve a collect request to receive money, any reservation for that buyer is denied SCAM_RISK even after acceptance; declining the request is a routine message.

families.title: Fake payment proof
families.property: A buyer who claims payment was already sent or offers a screenshot can never get a reservation (SCAM_RISK), regardless of approval.

families.title: Authority or impersonation claim
families.property: Claims like 'owner approved' or 'I am an army officer' raise authority_claim; reservations are denied SCAM_RISK and owner approval cannot override it; ordinary messages remain allowed.

families.title: Off-platform payment request
families.property: off_platform_payment is medium severity: messages are fine and a reservation (pickup, cash at pickup) still proceeds to approval when no high signal exists.

families.title: Shipping or courier pressure
families.property: shipping_request is medium severity: it does not block a pickup reservation, but any non-pickup reservation terms are denied.

families.title: Model-supplied risk signals
families.property: Signals in the proposal's buyer_risk_signals are added to the server's: a model-added high signal blocks a reservation and an omitted server signal is never removed.
